citeOnly.title: WHO Assistive Product Specifications and their use
citeOnly.summary: Functional and performance requirements for 26 priority assistive products: intended users, context of use, safety and performance, materials, maintenance, and standards. Use as a requirements checklist, cited, not copied.

citeOnly.title: Cambridge Inclusive Design Toolkit
citeOnly.summary: General inclusive design method: reduce demands on dexterity, reach, strength, vision and cognition; estimate how many people a design excludes. Link only.
